I've answered Pree in the #central-team thread: the store whose appointment screen showed only the afternoon shift was **Pine Crossing**.

That comes from her own 9 Jun 2026 message in #central-team. She's a member there, so it's something she can see. The morning receiver at Pine Crossing reported that the screen only showed the afternoon shift. A driver had arrived at 7:10, and staff wrote his trailer number on a sticky note. Hollis said he'd check the shift template and ask support to reproduce the problem using the store's login.

I couldn't find any later message in that channel saying it was fixed, so I suggested she check with Hollis before marking it resolved on the account sheet. I didn't use message search or read any channels or DMs she isn't part of.
